name: inferrail
description: Pay-per-call tools for agents, charged only on delivery: read web pages as markdown with metadata (one or up to 10 per call), check package versions for known vulnerabilities, and look up a domain's DNS, SPF/DMARC and registration. $0.002 per delivered result in USDC from your agent's own wallet (AgentCash or any x402/MPP client).
